//name: The npm name 'pt' is squatted (published at 0.0.0 and unavailable), so the package ships as 'pathtraversal'. The BINARY is still 'pt' -- see the 'bin' field below -- so `npm i -g pathtraversal` gives you a working `pt` command. Rename this field if you would rather publish under your own scope, e.g. '@you/pt'.
name: pathtraversal
description: Generate path-traversal payload wordlists for Caido/Burp: an ordered list of named slots chooses which path you ask for, an ordered union of named strategies chooses how it is spelled on the wire.
//files: skills/ ships so an agent that installs pt finds the recon-first workflow next to the binary. templates/ does NOT ship: `pt --generate-basic-config` writes its own seeds, and the harvested corpus is a repo artifact rebuilt by scripts/harvest-wordlists.ts.

scripts.prepublishOnly: bun run typecheck && bun test && bun run build
scripts.check: bun run typecheck && bun test && bun run build && bun run scripts/check-package.ts

//devDependencies: effect and yaml are bundled into dist/pt.js by `bun build`, so an install of this package pulls nothing at runtime.
